يلذ (form I)
# يَلَذُّ (yalaḏḏu) /ja.lað.ðu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of لَذَّ (laḏḏa)
# يُلَذُّ (yulaḏḏu) /ju.lað.ðu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of لَذَّ (laḏḏa)
# يَلَذَّ (yalaḏḏa) /ja.lað.ða/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of لَذَّ (laḏḏa)
# يُلَذَّ (yulaḏḏa) /ju.lað.ða/: third-person masc
